name: Park
summary: In Stormwind's western edge, Park offers visiting night elves a haven amid the stone city. It lies between Cathedral Square and the Mage Quarter, with greenery and quiet for rest. Druid trainers here are the only ones in the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: A Grove in the Stone Capital
sections.body: Stormwind's Park brings a quiet stretch of wilderness into the stone capital. Once a place for the city's people to seek recreation, it became an enclave for night elf emissaries and travelers from across the Great Sea. Shaded canopies shelter the district, and a central Moonwell stands amid its grounds. The grove offers a glimpse of Kalimdor's sacred glades in the heart of the human kingdom.

sections.title: Sanctuary and Fellowship
sections.body: Night elves have a foothold in foreign lands within the Park. Kaldorei priests such as Nara Meideros tend visiting pilgrims, while druidic mentors guide those devoted to the wild. Weary travelers can also rest from the clatter of the Trade District and the solemn duties of the Cathedral.

faq.q: Where is the Park located in Stormwind?
aliases: how to get to the park
faq.answer: Park lies along Stormwind City's far western edge. You can reach it by heading southwest from Cathedral Square or northwest from the Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Why are there so many night elves in the Park?
faq.answer: Visiting night elves found refuge in Park to escape Stormwind's towering stone streets. Its groves and serene air reminded them of home, and they established a Moonwell in the square.

faq.q: Can I train druid abilities here?
aliases: where to train druid eastern kingdoms
faq.answer: Yes. Park is the only place in the Eastern Kingdoms with Alliance druid trainers, who offer Kaldorei practitioners guidance and training away from Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the glowing pool in the center of the Park?
faq.answer: The pool at the center of Park is a consecrated night elven Moonwell. Kaldorei visitors created it as a sacred font of spiritual peace and lunar power amid the human city.

angles.text: Park gives night elves a welcome taste of home, with a glowing Moonwell and familiar teachers of Elune and the wild.
In Park, you find your sole sanctuary for druid training and counsel across the Eastern Kingdoms.
